title: Resigned from a path toward further imperial office after placing
statement: Resigned from a path toward further imperial office after placing first in the 1894 top-level civil service examination, and instead built the Dasheng Cotton Mill in Nantong starting in 1895.
outcome: Dasheng Cotton Mill grew into a diversified Nantong-based industrial and educational group (mills, fisheries, salt works, schools, a museum) and is described by China Daily and Berkshire Publishing as a foundational episode in China's early industrialization.

title: Took an official post as Industrial and Commercial Secretary in Yuan
statement: Took an official post as Industrial and Commercial Secretary in Yuan Shikai's early Republican government in 1913, then resigned in 1915 to return to Nantong.
outcome: Zhang resigned his national government post in 1915 and returned to focus on Nantong's local industrial and education projects until his death in 1926.
